X and Y . Then; we found change of basis that transformed this ma trix operation into the standard matrix transpose; such that in this atypical basis the system's operators were either symmetric or skew-symmetric. Finally; by tensorthese operators using the Pauli matrices; we formed single skew-symmetric matrix whose Pfaffian's sign discriminates between   which atomic limits a given system can be connected to without closing the system's local gap. Altogether; by using results from matrix homotopy; this argument yields an energy-resolved invariant for classifying fragile topology as well as a quantitative measure of topological protection. ing sists of bilayer   honeycomb  lattice; as schematically shown in 1(a), where t1 and t2 represent the intraand  inter-layer  hopping amplitudes;  respectively.
